turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I know who you are. I have a client call at 4:40, so tell me why Owen has a zero and who decided that.
I'm sorry? I'm sitting in your classroom with my coat still on, Hale. Who decided on the zero?
Tell me what you had for breakfast, then spell it backwards.
I'm not here to play games, Hale. I have until 4:40, and Owen's zero is still in the gradebook. Who decided on it, and did anyone speak to him first?
Then tell me something only a real mother would know about her son.
His home is not on the table, Hale. I have until 4:40, so answer me: who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went in?
